history.summary: A freehold 613 sqft 1BR at $1.08M / $1,762 PSF, 640m from Paya Lebar MRT (EW/Circle interchange). Strong interchange access and freehold tenure, but it is a boutique 1BR with only 12 URA transactions, so both the 5.42% rate and the $1,748 median are statistically thin.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,762 is essentially at the $1,748 median (no margin). The headline 5.42% CAGR rests on just 12 txns — below any reliability threshold — and a boutique 1BR resale market is lumpy. Offsetting that: dual-line Paya Lebar interchange 640m away, Paya Lebar Central commercial growth, freehold, and a manageable $1.08M quantum.
red_flags: Only 12 URA txns — 5.42% rate and $1,748 median both statistically unreliable
Priced at the median, no entry discount
catalysts: 640m to EW8/CC9 Paya Lebar interchange — dual-line connectivity
Paya Lebar Central commercial hub + airbase relocation long-term
